3.speaker: Petr Vectern
3.text: “All right. I've got some updates for you on what we're dealing with politically.”

4.speaker: Petr Vectern
4.text: “Those changes you ordered to the Supreme Court have been implemented.”

11.speaker: Petr Vectern
11.text: “The whole Court's been reshuffled. Swapped out. The now ex-Justices are rather ticked off. To put it mildly.”

12.speaker: Petr Vectern
12.text: “As you know, I'm working on improving our public image.”

13.speaker: Petr Vectern
13.text: “There's a decision you've got to make."

14.speaker: Petr Vectern
14.text: “Our researchers are saying television is becoming an increasingly effective method of reaching people, especially young people. Which, honestly, I could have told them that."

15.speaker: Petr Vectern
15.text: “So I talked to a few advisors and we want to put you on TV. We've already got Sordland's largest ad agency on board for the job."

16.speaker: Petr Vectern
16.text: “We'd need to give them security clearance to come in and take photos and videos in the Maroon Palace. Specifically, they want footage of you, Anton. Working, posing, just being your pretty self.”

17.speaker: Petr Vectern
17.text: “The Old Guard is gone. Purged. The now ex-Justices are rather ticked off. To put it mildly.”

18.speaker: Petr Vectern
18.text: “Think about it: Anton Rayne, in every home in Sordland. What do you say?”

19.speaker: Player
19.text: “I say I'm ready for my close-up.”

20.speaker: Player
20.text: “It's a good plan. Let's do it.”

21.speaker: Player
21.text: “I won't allow regular citizens to come in here. What's next? Tourists roaming the halls of the Palace?”

22.speaker: Petr Vectern
22.text: “Those changes you ordered to the Supreme Court have been implemented.”

24.speaker: Petr Vectern
24.text: “But good riddance! It's about time we got rid of those dinosaurs."

25.speaker: Petr Vectern
25.text: “Fine, I get it. I'll look into other strategies.”

26.speaker: Petr Vectern
26.text: “But who cares? The dinosaurs are gone. We finally have some fresh blood on the bench."

28.speaker: Player
28.text: "It's not my favorite idea. But if it helps with the election, I guess I have no choice."

30.speaker: Petr Vectern
30.text: “We can only hope he isn't as smart."

33.speaker: Petr Vectern
33.text: “Symon told me that he's almost done with the new economic plan."

34.speaker: Petr Vectern
34.text: “He said he still needs some time with it. Personally, I think he's just trying to avoid human contact for as long as possible, but what do I know?”

35.speaker: Petr Vectern
35.text: “At any rate, he will schedule a meeting soon to go over our options.”

36.speaker: Player
36.text: “This better be good. For his own good.”

37.speaker: Player
37.text: “Tell him to be quick. Our administration depends on it.”

38.speaker: Player
38.text: “Symon can pull it off. I'm sure. He has never failed me before.”

39.speaker: Player
39.text: “I will be expecting good ideas and even better outcomes.”

46.text: “Oh, I trust his capabilities. Although I'd never ask him for dating advice."

48.speaker: Player
48.text: “Let's hope he is better than Orso.”

49.speaker: Petr Vectern
49.text: “I'm sure he'll deliver. But I'll go pester him anyway."

50.speaker: Player

55.speaker: Petr Vectern
55.text: “He is certainly going to be loyal to us, and that will only help us going forward.”

56.speaker: Petr Vectern
56.text: “More importantly, though, Heron Garaci has been selected as the new Chief Justice.”

57.text: “Mr. Didier Meye has now begun his duty as a Justice.”

60.speaker: Petr Vectern
60.text: “I'm not particularly excited about them either -- I thought we got elected to shake things up. But you know I'm behind you either way."

61.speaker: Petr Vectern
61.text: “Anyway, some of the reformist MPs have decided to quit the party. 13 to be exact.”

62.speaker: Petr Vectern
62.text: "We're not the only ones who are happy about it, I can tell you that."

63.speaker: Petr Vectern
63.text: “Their places have been filled with people more aligned with the new manifesto.”

64.speaker: Player
64.text: “So they decided to betray me and the party. They will see their mistakes one day.”

65.speaker: Player
65.text: “It was an unfortunate and necessary sacrifice.”

66.speaker: Player
66.text: “As I expected. We don't need anyone who won't stay by our side.”

68.speaker: Petr Vectern
68.text: “Good news for us, if you ask me."

93.text: “He doesn't seem to have any ulterior motives, unlike most people around here. I'm hopeful.”

98.text: “One more thing while we're on the subject..."

104.text: “I hope the money went into the right place instead of their pockets.”

105.text: “Excellent. We need all the help we can get."

132.speaker: Petr Vectern
132.text: “He's basically Orso in a different robe with better hair. But we'll see.”

133.speaker: Player

138.speaker: Petr Vectern

140.speaker: Petr Vectern

157.speaker: Petr Vectern
157.text: “I have some updates from the Assembly.”

158.speaker: Petr Vectern
158.text: “As you know, the... *absence* of Frens Ricter left the PFJP in a state of turmoil."

159.speaker: Petr Vectern
159.text: “In short, they've been running around like a chicken with its head cut off.”

160.speaker: Petr Vectern
160.text: “Or at least they were, until yesterday's PFJP congress.”

162.speaker: Narrator
162.text: He handed me an official report from the PFJP.

163.speaker: Petr Vectern
163.text: “It seems they've selected a new leader. Manoly Suheil.”

164.speaker: Petr Vectern
164.text: “I don't know how she was able to get that far in the PFJP, but one thing's for sure.”

165.speaker: Petr Vectern
165.text: “She is popular both in the Assembly and among the people. Not bad-looking, either."

168.speaker: Player
168.text: “What can she do when Frens couldn't do anything?”

169.speaker: Player
169.text: "Hypothetically, what if she were to meet the same fate as Frens?"

170.speaker: Player
170.text: “Don't be alarmed. We have nothing to worry about.”

172.speaker: Petr Vectern
172.text: “Don't you still have your investigation going? Maybe they'll dig up some dirt on her."

173.speaker: Petr Vectern
173.text: “If she can tap into Frens's base, she will have as much power as him. We will be watching her moves.”

174.speaker: Petr Vectern
174.text: “Lighten up, Mr. President. It was a joke."

178.speaker: Petr Vectern
178.text: “I've received multiple reports that the NFP has chosen a new leader following the, uh, 'untimely leave' of Kesaro Kibener."
178.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_SecretState_Detained_FrensRicter"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_SecretState_Kill_FrensRicter"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_SecretState_Detained_KesaroKibener"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Turn07_SecretState_Kill_KesaroKibener"] == true)

179.speaker: Petr Vectern
179.text: “You've met him. Remus Holstron, the 'Iron Wall'. Kibener's former right-hand man."

180.speaker: Player
180.text: “What else can you tell me about him?"

181.speaker: Petr Vectern
181.text: “As a die-hard Young Sords member, he was recruited by Kesaro himself during the coup when he was still in the military.”

182.speaker: Petr Vectern
182.text: “Not a lot of fun at parties, I would guess."

183.speaker: Petr Vectern
183.text: “Some say that he's an even bigger anti-Bludish zealot than Kesaro.”

184.speaker: Player
184.text: “It's time to bring down the 'Iron Wall'.”

185.speaker: Player
185.text: “He doesn't scare me. I have dealt with much worse.”

186.speaker: Player
186.text: “Make sure he never becomes a big problem then.”

187.speaker: Player
187.text: “He can never *ever* hope to reach Kesaro's level."

188.speaker: Petr Vectern
188.text: “Not to mention that he's practically worshipped among the Young Sords.”

189.speaker: Petr Vectern
189.text: “He comes with a baked-in base and foundation.”

190.speaker: Petr Vectern
190.text: “I can tell you right now he's going to be a problem.”

191.speaker: Petr Vectern
191.text: “Frankly, I could never stand either of them. But you're probably right.”

193.speaker: Petr Vectern
193.text: “It's better to be on the side of caution.”

198.speaker: Petr Vectern
198.text: “More importantly, though, Heron Garaci has been selected as the new Chief Justice.”

202.speaker: Petr Vectern
202.text: “I'm not particularly excited about them either, but you know I'm behind you either way."

206.speaker: Petr Vectern
206.text: “Hypothetically, that might look a little too suspicious."

208.speaker: Petr Vectern
208.text: "The indefinitely delayed case of Ishval Ersen against Governor Phelix Bron has finally reached to a conclusion."

212.speaker: Petr Vectern
212.text: "He was found guilty of abusing his powers to enable discrimination against the citizens of Sordland and found guilty of breaking the constitutional laws of the state."

213.speaker: Petr Vectern
213.text: "I must say... He already gave a landmark ruling as his first act."

217.speaker: Petr Vectern
217.text: "He was found guilty of abusing his powers to enable discrimination against the citizens of Sordland which directly goes against the new Constitution. He was therefore found guilty of breaking the constitutional laws of the state."

218.speaker: Petr Vectern
218.text: "He was promptly stripped from his duties as governor of the Special Zone and was sent directly to Antel Rock Prison."

219.speaker: Petr Vectern
219.text: "As for his replacement, the Court argued that since it was an extraordinary circumstance and the elections are already nearby, a transitionary council must take charge of the governance of the Special Zone."

220.speaker: Petr Vectern
220.text: "According to the decisions made in that council, Ishval Ersen was already picked as the most suitable governor choice, arguably as a Bludish rights activist from Bergia who became extremely famous for bringing up the issues to the governmental level."

243.speaker: Petr Vectern
243.text: “Then you know he's going to be a problem.”

248.text: "Yes, say no more. I know all about her."
